question.problem:
$$
D=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ -4 & 6 & 7 \\ 8 & -8 & -11\end{aligned}]
$$

If $D=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $D$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{31}\cdot {u}_{22}?$
question.worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $D$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}D & =[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ -4 & 6 & 7 \\ 8 & -8 & -11\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-2){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 2 & 1 \\ 8 & -8 & -11\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 2 & 2 & 1 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & 0 \\ -4 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{31}=-4$ and ${u}_{22}=2,$ we get

$$
{l}_{31}\cdot {u}_{22}=(-4)\cdot 2=-8.
$$
